description:
Research Summary

This University of Exeter project develops Bayesian machine-learning approaches to precision treatment of type 2 diabetes.

It is a dry-lab project within the GW4 BioMed MRC doctoral funding competition.

Official Project Title

Advancing Bayesian machine learning methods for precision medicine applications in Type 2 diabetes

Research Focus and Methods

Use large observational electronic health-record datasets to model variation in treatment response. Develop statistical methods that use individual characteristics to support treatment selection.

Research Training and Development

The four-year programme combines project research, core training and a Broadening Horizons placement.

Funding and Duration

Studentship funding and award conditions
ComponentDetails
AwardPhD studentship; selection is competitive
ProgrammeMRC GW4 BioMed
DurationFour years
StipendUKRI-rate living stipend. The programme quotes £21,805 per year for 2026/27; the 2027/28 rate is not yet published on the checked funding page.
Tuition and research supportFour-year competitive studentship covering tuition, stipend and programme research/training support.
Award conditionsFunding and project allocation are competitive. Visa, health-surcharge and relocation costs are not covered.
Stipend amount status£21,805 is the published 2026/27 reference rate. Subsequent academic-year rates and the amount in an individual funding offer should be checked separately.

Eligibility and English Language

Applicant qualifications and funding eligibility
ComponentDetails
Applicant eligibilityUK and international applicants; no international-fee gap for awarded places. International recruitment is capped at 30% of the cohort.
Academic preparationNormally a first or upper-second-class relevant degree or international equivalent; lower-second routes require additional master’s or strong professional evidence.
Project interests and skillsQuantitative, computing, mathematical and physical-science backgrounds are welcomed alongside medical sciences; project code PHS27Ex McKinley.
English languageMeet the host university’s English-language admission rules. An approved alternative or exemption may apply; IELTS is not universally mandatory.

Application Dates and Location

Deadline, start date and research location
ItemDetails
Application deadline21 October 2026; check the programme’s submission cutoff time before applying
Start date2027 entry; exact start date not specified
Research locationExeter, United Kingdom

How to Apply

  1. Apply to GW4 BioMed first using its online application route and project code PHS27Ex McKinley.
  2. Read the application checklist and prepare answers using its template; one application may name up to two projects.
  3. Apply formally to Exeter after accepting a funding offer, as instructed by the programme.

The exact start date and application cutoff time should be confirmed with the programme. A single programme application may identify up to two projects.
